description: Figure 3, captioned "Results of Ablation Study," is a composite bar chart displaying two separate vertical bar plots side-by-side, one for the PHEME dataset and one for the PolitiFact dataset. Each plot shows the accuracy (%) of the DAE model under different ablation settings. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)," ranges from 75.0% to 95.0% with major gridlines at 75.0, 80.0, 85.0, 90.0, and 95.0. The horizontal axis in each plot contains five categories representing different ablation conditions: "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." Each category is represented by a single colored bar whose height corresponds to its accuracy value, which is labeled directly above the bar. In the PHEME plot, the bars are colored dark red, orange, light yellow, light blue, and dark blue, respectively, with values of 89.84%, 86.82%, 80.10%, 88.80%, and 87.34%. In the PolitiFact plot, the bars are colored dark red, orange, light yellow, light blue, and dark blue, respectively, with values of 90.57%, 85.85%, 83.02%, 89.62%, and 87.74%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order listed on the x-axis.
